mapper.select: SELECT CAST(gm.category_id AS CHAR) AS categoryId, gm.category_name AS categoryName, CAST(gm.category_id AS CHAR) AS id, gm.category_name AS name FROM goods_main gm WHERE gm.camp_id = #{campId} AND gm.is_deleted = 0 AND gm.room_category_type IN (1, 2, 3) AND gm.category_id IS NOT NULL AND gm.category_name IS NOT NULL AND gm.category_name != '' AND (gm.room_category_type IS NULL OR gm.category_id != gm.room_category_type) GROUP BY gm.category_id, gm.category_name ORDER BY gm.category_id ASC
